newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Grajewo IPO seven times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Grajewo IPO seven times subscribed.

text.p: The 550,000 initial public share offering of the Polish chipboard maker Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA (Grajewo) was seven times subscribed, Grajewo said in a statement on Monday.

It said investors subscribed for 2,876,155 shares against 260,000 shares offered in the large investor tranche and for 438,435 shares against 90,000 offered in the small investor tranche. In the closed, 200,000-share tranche for current shareholers investors subscribed for 335,460 shares.
The issue was open to subscriptions from January 20 to 24. The issue price for all tranches was 90 zlotys per share.

Grajewo said bids in the large investor tranche have been reduced proportionately by 90.96 percent and in the small investor tranche by 79.47 percent. The average reduction in the closed tranche was 40.38 percent.
Grajewo said that it would ask the bourse to approve the shares for trade on the Warsaw stock exchange as soon as all necessary formalities were completed.
